【找補習老師三步曲】
1.選擇不同科目，設定補習需求。
2.智能配對老師，洽談細節。
3.確認補習日期，做好準備上課。
 
=========您關心的細節=========
 
【頂尖導師自由選擇】
100,000名大學私補導師，不論年級、學科，都有專業補習導師提供上門補習服務。
 
【AI 智能配對 快速尋師】
提交要求後，最快1分鐘聯繫補習老師，即時聯絡。
 
【嚴格篩選師資透明】
專人核實導師成績和資歷，並根據學生家長評價和數據分析，定期檢討補習導師質素，保証平台導師整體教學質素。

保證公平對待每一位用戶，重視學生、家長及導師利益，實時回饋及評價平台機制，聆聽用戶意見。
 
【大數據助尋找良師】
根據海量教學數據進行分析，以課堂回饋及用戶選擇、喜好進行有效的導師推薦，確保導師會提供最優質的私人教學。
 
【不同地區不同科目】
上門補習覆蓋全港十八區，一應俱全；不論DSE中學文憑試、校內試、升中試、呈分試、IELTS、IB課程、GCE、GCESE，亦能配對優質補習導師；功課輔導、中小學全科、中文、英文、數學、通識、理科、文科、商科、鋼琴、小提琴等不同類型補習老師，隨時上門輔導。
 
【照顧不同程度需要】
針對傳統補習社難以照顧不同程度學生需要，想教師拔尖補底，一切由你決定。
 
【大學導師知識傳承】
大學導師多年考試經驗，透過傳授知識回饋學生，上門補習賺取額外收入。


=========用戶推薦=========

「英文堂導師現在幫仔仔教英文0k，暫時教緊，非常謝謝你們的幫助！」 - 家長蔡小姐

「好開心啊, 咁多學生都係你地度揀我～所以我而家都只係係你地度搵學生啦, 冇用其他網～因爲你地真係好」 - 英文私補名師 Ho Sir

record.name: OmniStudy: AI Revision
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Struggling to revise effectively? OmniStudy AI is your personal exam coach, built specifically for UK students preparing for GCSE and A-Level exams.

Powered by advanced AI, OmniStudy generates tailored study materials matched to your exact exam board; whether that's AQA, OCR, Edexcel, WJEC, or others. No more searching for the right resources. Just pick your subjects, and start revising smarter.

SMART REVISION, NOT HARDER REVISION

OmniStudy adapts to you. It tracks what you know, identifies your weak spots, and focuses your revision where it matters most. Every flashcard, every practice question, every study session is personalised to your syllabus, your tier, and your progress.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE APP

Exam-Style Questions: AI-generated practice questions with instant marking and detailed feedback, tailored to your exam board and tier (Foundation or Higher)
Flashcards: Auto-generated revision cards for every topic on your syllabus
AI Tutor: Chat with your personal tutor anytime. Stuck on a homework question? Snap a photo and get step-by-step help
Knowledge Organisers: Beautiful visual summaries of key topics, generated on demand
Source Library: Upload your own notes and past papers. The AI becomes your personal mark scheme generator
Predicted Grades: Track your progress and see where you're heading based on your performance
THE REVISION ARCADE: LEARN BY PLAYING

Revision doesn't have to be boring. Choose from 12 unique study games:

Mastery Climb: One life, infinite questions. How far can you go?
Fill the Gap: Complete sentences with missing key terms
Parent vs Student: Challenge your parents to a revision battle
60 Second Rush: Answer as many questions as possible in one minute
Essay Elite: Timed essay practice with AI marking
Be The Examiner: Mark an AI student's work. Can you spot the mistakes?
Exam Prep: Sit a past paper and get instant feedback on the questions and get a predicted grade. 
...and 6 more games to keep revision fresh and engaging

EXAM COUNTDOWN

See exactly how many days until each of your exams with our built-in Summer 2026 timetable for AQA, Edexcel, OCR, and WJEC.

BILINGUAL SUPPORT

Full Welsh language support (Cymraeg) throughout the app, including dedicated Welsh reading comprehension exercises aligned to WJEC CBAC TGAU specifications.

SUBSCRIPTION TIERS

Free: 1 subject, full access to revision tools and games
Premium: Up to 5 subjects, AI Tutor unlocked
Pro: Unlimited subjects, all features unlocked
YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICE

Your revision data lives on your device first. Optionally create a Cloud Account to back up your progress and restore it on any device; perfect when you upgrade your phone before exams.

Download OmniStudy AI today and start revising with confidence. Your exams are coming; make every study session count.

You already have the idea. This app helps turn it into a better prompt — clearer, more efficient, and more token-friendly.

Transform rough ideas, long instructions, or existing prompts into structured, ready-to-use prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, image generators, coding assistants, and other AI tools.

The app removes unnecessary wording, improves structure and clarity, and helps reduce token usage while maintaining high-quality AI outputs.

BETTER PROMPTS. FEWER TOKENS. LOWER COSTS

Optimize prompts by improving:

• Instruction clarity
• Context and task definition
• Output requirements
• Structure and formatting
• Constraints, tone, and audience
• AI model compatibility
• Unnecessary wording and token usage

Better prompts can help reduce input tokens, limit unnecessary output, lower API costs, and produce clearer, more consistent results.

REFINE UNTIL IT FEELS RIGHT

Use Prompt Refinement to adjust an existing prompt without starting over.

Make it shorter, more detailed, more professional, more creative, change the tone or audience, modify constraints, adjust the output format, or optimize it for another AI model.

REVERSE PROMPT FROM EXISTING CONTENT

Create reusable prompts from:

• Images
• Videos
• Text
• Accessible URLs

Reverse Prompt analyzes elements such as style, composition, intent, format, movement, structure, and content patterns to generate a practical reusable prompt.

OPTIMIZED FOR CHATGPT

This app is designed to provide its best optimization experience for ChatGPT.

It improves role definition, context, instructions, constraints, and output formatting while removing unnecessary content — helping ChatGPT understand your request with fewer tokens.

This is especially useful for ChatGPT API workflows, where reducing unnecessary input and output tokens can help lower overall costs.

Optimized prompts can also be used with Claude, Gemini, image and video generators, coding assistants, writing tools, research tools, and more.

BUILT FOR EVERYDAY AI WORK

Useful for creators, designers, developers, marketers, founders, researchers, students, prompt engineers, and teams using AI at scale.

Turn messy prompts into clear, efficient instructions, reduce unnecessary token usage, and get better control over AI quality and costs.

Einfache Umsetzung kreativer Ideen 

  • Exportiere deine Videos in 4K ohne Wasserzeichen und teile sie auf jeder Plattform. 
  • Verwalte alle deine Entwürfe und Videos zentral an einem Ort. 
  • Nimm hochwertige Clips mit einer Länge von bis zu 10 Minuten auf und beginne sofort mit der Bearbeitung. 
  • Teile sie ganz einfach in hoher Qualität auf Instagram. 

Leistungsstarke Tools zum Erstellen und Bearbeiten 

  • Bearbeite Videos mit Frame-genauer Präzision. 
  • Verleihe deinen Videos mit Kameraeinstellungen zu Auflösung, Framerate und Dynamikumfang sowie verbesserten Steuerelementen für Blitz und Zoom den gewünschten Look. 
  • Erwecke Bilder mit KI-Animationen zum Leben. 
  • Verändere deinen Hintergrund mit Greenscreen, Cutouts oder füge ein Video-Overlay hinzu. 
  • Wähle aus einer Vielzahl an Schriftarten, Sound- und Spracheffekten, Videofiltern und -effekten, Stickern und vielem mehr. 
  • Verbessere die Audioqualität, damit Stimmen besser hörbar sind, und entferne unerwünschte Hintergrundgeräusche.

record.description_evidence:
OpenCall: AI Call Agent lets you make smarter phone calls — powered by AI.

Set your goal, choose a voice, and let OpenCall’s AI agent call and speak on your behalf. Whether you need to order food, book an appointment, or follow up with customer service, OpenCall handles the conversation from start to finish.

KEY FEATURES

AI-Powered Phone Calls
Tell the AI what you need, and it calls and speaks naturally on your behalf.

Smart Call Preparation
Before each call, OpenCall asks the right questions so the AI has the details it needs — address, preferred time, budget, payment method, and more.

Ready-Made Templates
Use templates for common calls like food delivery, doctor appointments, bill negotiations, hotel bookings, subscription cancellations, support calls, and more.

Real-Time Live Transcripts
Follow the conversation live and see exactly what the AI says and how the recipient responds.

Voice Cloning & Custom Voices
Clone your own voice from a short recording or design a custom AI voice that fits your needs.

Instruct the AI Mid-Call
Type instructions during a live call, such as “ask about the price” or “be more assertive,” and the AI adjusts instantly.

Supervisor Mode & Call Takeover
Monitor the call in real time and take over whenever a human touch is needed.

Caller ID Verification
Verify your phone number so recipients can see your real caller ID instead of an unknown number.

Multiple Identities
Create saved identities for personal, business, or client calls, including name, phone number, address, account details, and custom context.

Call History
Review past calls with transcripts, summaries, duration, credits used, and call status. Reuse previous call setups with one tap.

Multilingual Support
Make calls in 30+ languages with natural pronunciation and local-style communication.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Set your goal
2. Answer smart preparation questions
3. Choose or create a voice
4. Tap to call
5. Watch the live transcript
6. Review the result, summary, and full transcript

SUBSCRIPTION PLANS

OpenCall uses a credit-based system. 5 credits = 1 minute of AI call time.

Starter Weekly
- 100 credits / 20 minutes
- Up to 5 minutes per call
- AI calls, transcripts, preset voices
- Call history for last 10 calls

Plus Weekly
- 165 credits / 33 minutes
- Up to 10 minutes per call
- Includes Starter features
- Voice cloning
- Custom voice design
- Mid-call instructions
- Call takeover
- Full transcript access
- Call history for last 50 calls

Pro Monthly
- 550 credits / 110 minutes
- Up to 15 minutes per call
- Includes Plus features
- Unused credits roll over
- Unlimited call history

CREDIT TOP-UPS

Buy extra credits when needed:
- 25 credits / 5 minutes
- 75 credits / 15 minutes
- 150 credits / 30 minutes
- 400 credits / 80 minutes

Top-up credits carry forward even if your plan changes or renews. An active subscription is required to make calls. Plan credits do not carry forward on renewal, but top-up credits do.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.

You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

TRANSPARENCY & PRIVACY

Every call begins with a mandatory disclosure that the call is AI-assisted and being transcribed. The recipient always knows they are speaking with an AI.

OpenCall is built with privacy and compliance in mind. We do not sell your data, do not track you across apps, and you can delete your account and associated data at any time.

https://www.calify-ai.com/Privacy-Policy-OpenCall

Terms of Use:
